title: Per-Role Challenges & AI Mitigation
note: Each clinical role: real workflow challenges + how AI in this project mitigates each. status: built (real here) / partial / planned.

items.challenge: Reading EEG is slow (20-60 min/study), creating backlog
items.ai: AI pre-read flags seizure-risk windows + confidence so reading focuses on flagged segments
Consistent AI baseline + SHAP evidence anchors reads; concordance tracked
Model surfaces low-salience events for human confirmation
Decision audit trail + SHAP + override record = defensible evidence
Surrogate decision tree + SHAP make the model interpretable

items.challenge: Bad signal quality discovered only after the neurologist reads
items.ai: Auto signal-quality + impedance scan flags issues during acquisition
ICA auto-detects + removes artifact components (42% variance removed)
Auto artifact-segment flagging

items.challenge: Repeat recordings waste tech + patient time
items.ai: Real-time QC catches problems before the session ends
Differential model + survey-flag fusion (planned)
Auto-scored mood/anxiety surveys flag at-risk patients
Interaction checker (planned)

items.challenge: Tracking functional recovery over time is manual
items.ai: Outcome trend + goal-attainment analytics

items.challenge: Predicting which patients need intensive rehab
items.ai: Recovery-trajectory forecast — slope analysis + risk factor correlation from real pro_outcomes data
Standardized auto-scored instruments (COPM Dashboard + FIM Dashboard — 3+3 endpoints verified 200)

items.challenge: Neuropsych battery scoring is slow + error-prone
items.ai: Auto-scoring + normative comparison (MoCA/WAIS — MoCA Auto-Scoring Dashboard live, WAIS Dashboard live)
Cognitive-profile trend flags decline (partial)

items.challenge: Correlating MRI lesions with EEG focus
items.ai: EEG-MRI concordance view (planned)
Template + finding capture (partial)
Gateway monitors heartbeat + auto-reconnect + flags gaps

items.challenge: Detecting a seizure in real-time from a noisy wearable stream
items.ai: Edge model on streamed windows + confidence gate (sim)
Device Telemetry Dashboard — battery health, signal quality, connection status, degradation alerts (3 endpoints verified 200)

items.challenge: SOS must reach caregiver fast + reliably
items.ai: Multi-channel alert (phone/SMS) with escalation
Local-first gateway + PII scrub before any cloud
Immutable decision audit (who/what/when, UTC+local)
Guardrails (injection/PII) + fairness gate (DI/EO) per decision

items.challenge: Ensuring human stayed in the loop
items.ai: HITL override records + decision routing enforce oversight

items.challenge: Reconstructing a past decision for audit
items.ai: Council request_id trace + SHAP + audit row = full reconstruction
RAG conversation AI answers questions grounded in their records
Faster AI-assisted turnaround
